rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose choice for something ancient, without stressing that it belongs to the very first age.

example.english: People still walk across this primeval stone bridge today.
example.traditional: 呢座古老嘅石橋，到而家仲有人行。
example.jyutping: ne1 zo6 gu2 lou5 ge3 sek6 kiu4 dou3 ji4 gaa1 zung6 jau5 jan4 hang4

rows.note: Use this written term when you specifically mean belonging to the distant earliest ages.

example.english: These murals record the lives of primeval people.
example.traditional: 呢啲壁畫記錄咗遠古人嘅生活。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 bik1 waa2 gei3 luk6 zo2 jyun5 gu2 jan4 ge3 saang1 wut6

rows.note: Choose this for the primitive or undeveloped aspect of the meaning, rather than simply meaning old.

example.english: The people in that village still live a primeval way of life.
example.traditional: 嗰條村仲過住原始嘅生活。
example.jyutping: go2 tiu4 cyun1 zung6 gwo3 zyu6 jyun4 ci2 ge3 sang1 wut6
